name: DecodeIndexScore
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import json
import os
SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE = 128


def run(idx_q, index_kv_cache, block_table, seq_lens, init_blocks, local_blocks, decode_query_len):
    assert idx_q.dim() == 3, f'idx_q 应为 3D, got {idx_q.shape}'
    total_q, H, D = idx_q.shape
    P, BS, D2 = index_kv_cache.shape
    assert BS == SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE and D2 == D, f'cache 形状应为 [P, 128, {D}], got {index_kv_cache.shape}'
    B, max_block = block_table.shape
    assert seq_lens.shape[0] == B
    assert total_q == B * decode_query_len, f'total_q={total_q} != num_reqs({B}) * dql({decode_query_len})'
    dql = decode_query_len
    q = idx_q.float()
    score = torch.full((H, total_q, max_block), float('-inf'), dtype=torch.float32, device=idx_q.device)
    arange_bs = torch.arange(BS, device=idx_q.device)
    arange_q = torch.arange(dql, device=idx_q.device)
    for r in range(B):
        seq_len = int(seq_lens[r])
        sl = slice(r * dql, (r + 1) * dql)
        q_r = q[sl]
        query_pos = seq_len - dql + arange_q
        kv_len = (query_pos + 1).clamp(min=0)
        nb_q = (kv_len + BS - 1) // BS
        nb = min(int(nb_q.max().item()), max_block)
        local_start = (nb_q - local_blocks).clamp(min=0)
        for blk in range(nb):
            page = int(block_table[r, blk])
            k = index_kv_cache[page].float()
            qk = torch.einsum('kd,qhd->hqk', k, q_r)
            pos = blk * BS + arange_bs
            visible = pos[None, :] < kv_len[:, None]
            qk = torch.where(visible[None, :, :], qk, torch.full_like(qk, float('-inf')))
            s = qk.max(dim=-1).values
            is_vis = blk < nb_q
            is_local = (blk >= local_start) & is_vis
            is_init = (blk < init_blocks) & is_vis
            s = torch.where(is_local[None, :], torch.full_like(s, 1e+29), torch.where(is_init[None, :], torch.full_like(s, 1e+30), s))
            score[:, sl, blk] = s
    return score
